meta.title: Privacy — IGO
meta.description: How IGO handles the details sent through the early access form.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.sub: How we handle the details you send through the early access form.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.text: The data controller is: [name and contact details, to be completed].

data.title: What we collect
data.text: The details you enter in the early access form: your name, email address and product interest, and optionally your company, role and a message.

purpose.title: Why we use it
purpose.text: To reply to your request and to contact you about early access to IGO. We do not use your details for anything else.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.text: Your consent, which you give by ticking the box in the form. You can withdraw it at any time.

recipients.title: Who receives it
recipients.text: A form-processing service provider receives each request on our behalf and forwards it to us by email. We do not sell your details.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: Only as long as needed to handle your request and early access communications, or until you ask us to delete it.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your details, to restrict or object to their use, or to withdraw your consent, by contacting the controller above. You can also complain to your data protection authority.
